title: 伺服馬達編碼器整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討編碼器尺度、角度校準、同步取樣與錯誤診斷，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore encoder scaling, angle calibration, synchronous sampling and diagnostics, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。不同編碼器的線數、位元、更新率與協定定義不同；須核對資料表及時間語義，不保證任意接口可互換。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Line count, bits, update rates and protocol definitions vary; verify datasheets and timing semantics rather than assume interchangeable interfaces.

stages.title: 碼尺與介面
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成碼尺與介面；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete scales and interfaces through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 比較增量與絕對位置：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Compare incremental and absolute position: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較增量與絕對位置，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare incremental and absolute position through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 讓離線計數器失電後重啟，對照是否仍知道軸位置。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Power-cycle an offline counter and compare whether shaft position remains known. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 讓離線計數器失電後重啟，對照是否仍知道軸位置。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Power-cycle an offline counter and compare whether shaft position remains known. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較增量與絕對位置」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把編碼器尺度、角度校準、同步取樣與錯誤診斷的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare incremental and absolute position disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of encoder scaling, angle calibration, synchronous sampling and diagnostics behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較增量與絕對位置」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare incremental and absolute position, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 比較增量與絕對位置：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Compare incremental and absolute position: principle
knowledge.text: 增量介面記錄位移，絕對介面提供編碼位置，斷電後行為不同。
knowledge.textEn: Incremental interfaces track motion; absolute interfaces encode position, with different power-loss behavior.

knowledge.title: 比較增量與絕對位置：證據

knowledge.text: 讓離線計數器失電後重啟，對照是否仍知道軸位置。
knowledge.textEn: Power-cycle an offline counter and compare whether shaft position remains known.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：增量編碼器每圈 2,500 線，以四倍計數得到 10,000 counts/rev，機械解析度 0.036°。四極對馬達的電角解析度是 0.144°，而非 0.036°；解析度不代表絕對精度。 不同編碼器的線數、位元、更新率與協定定義不同；須核對資料表及時間語義，不保證任意接口可互換。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 2,500-line incremental encoder with quadrature x4 yields 10,000 counts/rev and 0.036° mechanical resolution. A four-pole-pair motor has 0.144° electrical resolution, not 0.036°. Resolution is not absolute accuracy. Line count, bits, update rates and protocol definitions vary; verify datasheets and timing semantics rather than assume interchangeable interfaces.

knowledge.text: 教學例：增量編碼器每圈 2,500 線，以四倍計數得到 10,000 counts/rev，機械解析度 0.036°。四極對馬達的電角解析度是 0.144°，而非 0.036°；解析度不代表絕對精度。 不同編碼器的線數、位元、更新率與協定定義不同；須核對資料表及時間語義，不保證任意接口可互換。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 2,500-line incremental encoder with quadrature x4 yields 10,000 counts/rev and 0.036° mechanical resolution. A four-pole-pair motor has 0.144° electrical resolution, not 0.036°. Resolution is not absolute accuracy. Line count, bits, update rates and protocol definitions vary; verify datasheets and timing semantics rather than assume interchangeable interfaces.

steps.title: 建立串列協定欄位：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Build serial protocol fields: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立串列協定欄位，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build serial protocol fields through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「位置位元、狀態、CRC 與時序字段有不同功能。」的觀察。分解一個合成封包，刻意改一位並檢查錯誤偵測結果。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Position bits, status, CRC and timing fields serve distinct roles. Decompose a synthetic packet, flip one bit and check error detection. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 分解一個合成封包，刻意改一位並檢查錯誤偵測結果。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Decompose a synthetic packet, flip one bit and check error detection. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立串列協定欄位」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把編碼器尺度、角度校準、同步取樣與錯誤診斷的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build serial protocol fields disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of encoder scaling, angle calibration, synchronous sampling and diagnostics behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立串列協定欄位」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build serial protocol fields, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
